title: Research AI Assistant
description: Create and discuss a clear, maintainable research project structure.

title: Excel Compare & XLSX Diff
description: Excel compare for VS Code: compare two Excel files (.xlsx, .xlsm, .xls, .ods) or CSV files cell by cell. Inserted rows are aligned, changed cells are marked, and you can step from change to change or compare a file with its Git HEAD version. Values or formulas. No network.

title: HTML Formatter & CSS Formatter
description: HTML formatter and CSS formatter for VS Code: format HTML, CSS, SCSS and LESS, and the style and script blocks inside HTML, with zero config. Reads .editorconfig, keeps <pre> and inline tags intact, never reorders attributes. Works offline.

title: Inkmap — Markdown Mind Map
description: Edit Markdown outlines as mind maps beside your editor or in Chrome; every change is written back to the Markdown.

title: Word Count HotCRP
description: Live word count that matches HotCRP's word limits, for the document or the current selection(s), with a character counter you can turn on and off. Fork of ms-vscode.wordcount.
